text:
carmen: Hey infra — planning a new GPU nodepool for a mixed L4 (low-latency) + A10G (throughput fallback) setup in asia-central1. Need quota check, sizing recs, and autoscaler policy. Target steady baseline ~10 GPUs, burst to ~60. Any blockers? :wave:

mike: What's the workload mix? realtime short-seq vs batched? pod GPU requests/limits?

carmen: Mix: ~50% realtime (small seq, want <50ms p95), 50% batched reranks. Pod requests: 1 GPU, cpu 4, mem 32Gi. Typical batch jobs can tolerate higher latency. Estimate 60 RPS peak across all pods.

nirav: For that I'd start with two nodepools: L4 preemptible burst pool and A10G ondemand for baseline. Suggest initial sizes: L4 pool min 0 / max 40 (preemptible), A10G pool min 5 / max 20 (ondemand). Taints and labels to control scheduling: `gpu=dedicated:NoSchedule` and node labels `type=l4|a10g`. Cluster-autoscaler config: one ASG per pool, scale-down delay 10m, balance-similar-node-groups enabled.

jo: Also check region capacity before we commit — some zones don't have L4. @quota-bot can you run a quick quota/capacity check for asia-central1 and nearby regions?

quota-bot: quick-check: asia-central1 quotas
- GPUs total quota: 24
- A10G available quota left: 12
- L4 SKU: NOT_AVAILABLE in asia-central1 (provider report)
- CPUs & IPs look fine
Recommendation: either switch to a region with L4 (asia-east1 has L4 capacity) or use L4-equivalent instance type if latency is okay. If you want L4 in asia-central1, we need a quota/capacity request with the provider — will take 2-5 business days.

carmen: Ugh — L4 not available in asia-central1. Latency to asia-east1 is ~10-15ms extra for our main clients; might still be acceptable for burst traffic. Alternatives? cross-region routing?

mike: We can do smart routing in the runtime: prefer local A10G for baseline, route realtime-critical requests to nearest L4 (asia-east1) when available. Add fallback policy in the service mesh / routing layer. Also ensure pod tolerations + nodeAffinity so realtime pods prefer nodes labeled `type=l4`. Example toleration/affinity snippet:
```yaml
tolerations:
  - key: "gpu"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "dedicated"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
nodeAffinity:
  preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
    - weight: 100
      preference:
        matchExpressions:
          - key: "type"
            operator: In
            values: ["l4"]
```

priya: Cost note: preemptible L4s are cheaper but less reliable; A10G ondemand baseline will be the bulk of the monthly cost. Roughly expect preemptible L4s to be ~30-40% of A10G hourly cost — we should run a quick calc once we pick sizes. Also watch NAT egress IP limits for cross-region traffic.

sre-bot: Checklist before provisioning:
- GPU device-plugin & driver daemonset tested on new image tag
- Node taints/labels + RBAC for autoscaler
- Add pod disruption budgets and health probes for realtime pods
- Preflight: run small cluster-autoscaler dry-run and simulate scale up
- Add alert: nodepool provisioning failures + excessive preemptions (>20% 1h)

carmen: Perfect — I'll open a capacity request for L4 in asia-east1 and a ticket to provision A10G pool in asia-central1 in the meantime. Will include the nodepool yaml and autoscaler policy. Posting sample nodepool create command for review:
```bash
# create a preemptible L4 pool (if capacity approved)
cloudctl nodepools create gen-burst-l4 --region asia-east1 --num-nodes 0 --min-nodes 0 --max-nodes 40 --machine-type n1-l4 --preemptible --labels type=l4,gpu=dedicated --taints gpu=dedicated:NoSchedule

# create A10G baseline pool in asia-central1
cloudctl nodepools create gen-baseline-a10g --region asia-central1 --num-nodes 5 --min-nodes 5 --max-nodes 20 --machine-type n1-a10g --labels type=a10g,gpu=dedicated --taints gpu=dedicated:NoSchedule
```

mike: LGTM. Add `max-unavailable: 20%` for rollout to avoid mass disruption. Also consider autoscaler expander strategy `most-pods` so it picks nodes that host more pods per GPU when scaling.

carmen: Thanks all — I'll proceed with the ticket + quota request and circle back once provider confirms L4 capacity. :+1:
